defect.cause: Canonical join() unconditionally initialized Coins=50, Wave=1, Defeated=0 and FactoryLevel=1; all progress was lost on a normal reconnect.
defect.reproduction: Run complete canonical server through injected DataStore mock: mutate four server-owned values, remove player, rejoin same UserId. Previous main resets values and never calls GetAsync/UpdateAsync; new test requires persisted roundtrip.

fix: Use optional ToyWarsProgressV1 DataStore with server-owned, bounded integer schema; restore four values before plot construction and derive enemyTarget from restored wave. Reserve plot during yielding load and fence disconnected players. Save on PlayerRemoving and BindToClose; never overwrite an unknown schema or a failed read.
character_impact: PON/GUARDON/TANKURU/JUNK stats, costs, visuals and combat formulas unchanged; progress restoration affects saved wave, factory level, coins and defeated count.

tests.negative_control: Old canonical main initializes default values on every join; no prior persistence API.

evidence.main_qa_note: Both jobs success; base main differs only in two generated status files.

limitations: No autosave during long sessions; abrupt server loss can lose progress since last successful save.
Real Roblox DataStore enablement, cross-server conflicts, quota and rejoin are unverified.
Malformed/unknown stored schema falls back to session defaults without overwriting prior record.
next_action: Rerun exact-head offline+compile_hold with corrected fixture; independent REVIEWER only after both jobs succeed. Roblox engine and DataStore remain NOT_RUN.

ci_repair.fix: Preserve Lua loadfile default environment when env is absent, and still inject DataStore only into canonical server env.
ci_repair.required_next: Exact new-head offline+compile_hold success; no old-head CI reuse.
